[1, 2, 6, 7] The walkout caused disruptions to non-essential medical services, though Kaiser stated that hospitals and emergency departments would remain open with contingency staff. [1, 2] The American Library Association (ALA) highlighted a continued rise in challenges and organized the week to raise awareness and defend the right to read for all.
